name: GAIN
fix_description: In _transferFrom, do not trigger _snap() (rebase) during a transfer. The rebase changes _gonsPerFragment mid-transfer, causing inconsistency between the deducted amount (calculated before rebase) and the received amount (calculated after rebase). Move rebase logic to a separate function that cannot be triggered within a transfer.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a protocol-specific multi-step AMM reserve-manipulation exploit: flash borrow WETH, interact with a thin Uniswap V2 pair using swap/skim/sync in sequence, then drain mispriced WETH and repay. The PoC is short, but understanding why the skim/sync sequence breaks GAIN/WETH accounting requires more than spotting a trivial bug, so it is above easy but not deeply complex.
